description: CSINodeStatus contains health and status information for storage on a node.

storageHealth.description: storageHealth contains backend health reports for CSI drivers registered on the node. This is an alpha field and requires enabling the CSIVolumeHealth feature gate.

items.description: StorageHealth contains storage backend health reported by a CSI driver on a node.

healthConditions.description: healthConditions are the storage backend conditions reported by the CSI driver. At most 16 conditions may be reported. An empty list means the CSI driver either does not support storage health or has not reported it yet. If the driver supports storage health and its storage backend is healthy, the kubelet reports a StorageHealthy condition.

items.description: StorageHealthCondition represents a health condition reported by a CSI driver for its storage backend on a node.

accessMode.description: accessMode is the access mode affected. Nil means all access modes are affected.

lastTransitionTime.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

message.description: message is a human-readable description. Maximum permitted length of a message is 1024 bytes.

reason.description: reason is a brief CamelCase machine-parseable reason. Maximum permitted length of a reason is 256 bytes.

status.description:
status is the health status category. Possible values are: - "StorageHealthUnknown": the driver reported an unknown health status, or a status Kubernetes does not recognize; the backend must not be considered healthy. - "StorageUnreachable": the storage backend is unreachable. - "StorageDegraded": the storage backend is functioning with reduced capability. - "StorageHealthy": the storage backend is healthy as seen from this node.

Additional values may be introduced as the CSI specification evolves. Writers that do not recognize a status may classify it as StorageHealthUnknown. Readers that do not recognize a status must use it only for health reporting and observability.

volumeMode.description: volumeMode is the volume mode affected. Nil means both are affected.

name.description: name is the CSI driver name, matching CSINodeDriver.name.
